title: How To Get A Free Lowes 10% Off Coupon - Email Delivery
description: This is a video of how to procure an email coupon good at any Lowe's home improvement store. The coupon is delivered to your email inbox and is good for 10% off any purchase.

asr.full_text: I know just enough about home improvement to be dangerous, and because of this sometimes I need to go to the home improvement store to buy supplies. And recently I found out about an online coupon good at Lowe's Home Improvement Stores. It's good for ten percent off of any purchase, and it's electronic. It's delivered right into your email. And here's how to get that coupon, first open up your internet and go to google and type in Lowes moving coupon and it's one of the first ones there and it's the first link it starts off with Lowes.com Moving Center click on that one and if you look right here it says save 10 percent on those purchases so we will request the coupons next we just need to fill out all the pertinent information so we'll do that. And you get the idea type in your email address blah'dy blah'dy blah'dy, blah'dyping your email address make sure that it's your correct email address because that's where the coupon will be sent you also have to enter your address and phone number idk why this is important because they don't mail you anything and I've requested a few of these coupons and they've never phoned me. After that's done, you enter the robot check and submit and then you have to wait. It usually takes 1 to 5 days days you can check your email, and you will find the coupon If you're the person that feels that they need more than one 10% off coupon, make sure that if you get multiple coupons you use a different email address because I don't think it would work with the same email address multiple times. The same may be true with the physical address, so might have to be a little bit shady if you want to try to be sneaky and get multiple Lowe's coupons but %10 is... nothing to sneeze at and hopefully it saves you some money Thanks for watching!

textual.limitations: These records do not establish whether the form, website, coupon, or Lowe's affiliation is genuine, nor whether any information was misused or any coupon was delivered.
